suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Giải pháp AI & Kiến trúc Luồng Tự động hóa
suggestions.reasoning: With 1.5 years of React and TypeScript experience, you already possess the core syntax foundation needed to build and connect modern digital interfaces. As highlighted by WEF (2023) and TopCV (2024), AI and Machine Learning Specialists represent the fastest-growing global and local roles, with enterprise demand surging as companies look to integrate LLMs into operational workflows. Your background in Front-end development allows you to rapidly prototype user-facing AI tools and connect APIs.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your strengths in rapid technology adoption and proactive self-learning match the fast-evolving nature of AI tooling. While your technical English and large-scale system experience are currently moderate constraints, your high risk tolerance and interest in AI/ML and Agent development provide an ideal psychological and skill-based runway to bridge these gaps without requiring high initial capital.
transferableSkillsMatch: API consumption and asynchronous data handling
skillsGap: Enterprise workflow automation and API orchestration with LLMs
Prompt engineering and model evaluation guardrails
Technical English for international engineering communication
Large-scale system design and latency/cost optimization
